run_score_annotator: run the annotate pairs dataset script with score annotator on a motif dataset directory
run_return_annotator: run the annotate pairs dataset script with return annotator to label trajectory pairs
run_llm_annotator: run the annotate pairs dataset script with a Llama-2 language model annotator
run_chunked_annotation: run the annotate pairs dataset script on a specific chunk for distributed processing
run_custom_annotator: run the annotate pairs dataset script with a custom annotator string tag
